A 90% win rate can still lose money. 📉

In our (hypothetical) simulation, a strategy that wins 97% of its trades but loses money in the long run showed a perfect record in 54% of its 20-trade backtests. A martingale with a 99.1% cycle win rate hit a failed cycle within 100 cycles in about 6 of 10 runs.

New on the blog:
• why win rate is only half of expectancy
• a perfect backtest that loses money
• martingale: a 99% win rate by design
• the 2015 Swiss franc shock and why stops can slip
• a checklist to spot hidden tail risk
